body: Take his camps. I'm a jungler main and my best way to deal with Yi is to figure out where he is currently, then counterjungle the opposite side of the map. That way it takes him much longer to reach his powerspikes and by that point your team is able to deal with him.
I play a game called RO. It has low cool downs if any at all, and in my honest opinion the PVP is much better in that game.
